Add timesheet_lines for weekly per-worker rows

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

after.hourglass/timesheet.py:
# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet rows built from a list of shifts."""

from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.models import Shift


# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts: Iterable[Shift]) -> List[str]:
    """One line per worker, like Brisa: 3 shifts, 12.5 hours, busiest first.

    ValueError when there are no shifts or a shift has a blank worker name.
    """
    counts = defaultdict(int)
    minutes = defaultdict(int)
    for shift in shifts:
        if not shift.worker.strip():
            raise ValueError("shift has a blank worker name")
        counts[shift.worker] += 1
        minutes[shift.worker] += shift.span.minutes
    if not counts:
        raise ValueError("no shifts to build a timesheet from")
    order = sorted(counts, key=lambda name: (-minutes[name], name))
    return [f"{name}: {counts[name]} shifts, {minutes[name] / 60:.1f} hours" for name in order]
